function_specs.name: _SemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Imported proven IC callee returns failure -5 with unchanged state, or publishes a fresh initialized semaphore under the minimum free ID; restores os_inv.

function_specs.name: KSemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Returns the same IC create result and resulting os_inv as its internal creation call, preserving the frozen semaphore_create_ic_effect.
